pa_newborn_nights.text: {{name}} screams every two hours. You have not finished a thought since Tuesday.

outcomes.works: Three rough nights, then silence. Glorious, guilty silence.
outcomes.worse: The crying only gets louder. So does your guilt.

pa_vaccines.text: The pediatrician hands you {{name}}'s vaccine schedule. Your feed has opinions. The doctor has a degree.

pa_first_word.text: {{name}} points at you and says a word. It sounds like your name. Or like a sneeze.

pa_daycare.text: Daycare costs more than your rent. {{name}} also needs somewhere to be while you work.

pa_picky_eater.text: {{name}} eats beige food only. A single green pea is treated like a hostile act.

outcomes.s: {{name}} eats the whole lasagna. You are a genius.
outcomes.f: They find every piece and line them up on the rim like evidence.

pa_public_tantrum.text: In the supermarket, {{name}} lies on the floor and screams that you are ruining their life. Strangers watch.

outcomes.calm: It ends in ninety seconds. A stranger gives you a nod of respect.
outcomes.meltdown: It escalates. You abandon the cart and leave in shame.

pa_daycare_bite.text: The daycare calls. {{name}} bit another kid. Hard.

choices.defend: Insist the other kid started it

pa_first_steps.text: {{name}} lets go of the couch and takes three wobbly steps toward you.

pa_story_night.text: {{name}} wants the same book for the fortieth night in a row. You now know it by heart.

choices.skip: Skip pages, hope they miss it

pa_first_school_day.text: First day of school. {{name}} clings to your leg like a koala with legal grievances.

outcomes.s: {{name}} waves, sniffs, and marches in. You cry in the car.
outcomes.f: The wailing follows you down the corridor for a full minute.

pa_report_card.text: {{name}} brings home a report card and hides it behind a cereal box.

outcomes.up: {{name}} beams and tries harder next term.
outcomes.shrug: A shrug. The effort is noted, nothing more.

pa_bullied.text: {{name}} comes home with a torn backpack and a story about a kid who won't leave them alone.

outcomes.s: The school acts. The bully is moved to another class.
outcomes.f: The principal shrugs and calls it 'kids being kids'.

pa_is_bully.text: A teacher calls. {{name}} has been tormenting a quiet kid. They are not sorry. Yet.

pa_talent.text: {{name}} seems to have an actual gift. A teacher says the word 'prodigy' and looks at your wallet.

outcomes.shines: Years later, you sit in the front row and cry on cue.
outcomes.quits: After a year, {{name}} quits. The instrument gathers dust.

pa_sports_team.text: {{name}} wants to join a team. Saturdays will now belong to a damp field.

outcomes.s: {{name}} scores. You scream like a lunatic and they pretend not to know you.
outcomes.f: They lose badly, and blame your cheering.

pa_music_lessons.text: {{name}} has started the violin. The house now sounds like a cat being negotiated with.

pa_screen_time.text: {{name}} has been on a screen for six hours straight. Their eyes have stopped blinking.

outcomes.s: Some grumbling, then actual outdoor play. Remarkable.
outcomes.f: They bargain like a union rep. You fold.

pa_broken_arm.text: {{name}} fell off the monkey bars. The arm bends where arms do not bend.

pa_lie_caught.text: {{name}} swears the dog ate the homework. You don't own a dog.

outcomes.s: You catch the lie in two questions. They respect it.
outcomes.f: They out-argue you. A future lawyer, perhaps.

pa_stole_wallet.text: Cash is missing from your wallet. {{name}} has suspiciously large amounts of candy.

outcomes.confess: They crumple, confess, and offer you a candy bar as repayment.
outcomes.deny: They deny it with a perfect straight face. You are both impressed and worried.

pa_puberty_talk.text: {{name}} is changing. The conversation you have been dreading is three days away. Or already here.

choices.other: Pass it to the other parent

outcomes.s: They listen, mortified, and later say thank you.
outcomes.f: They put their fingers in their ears and leave the room.

pa_first_phone.text: {{name}} says every kid in their class has a phone. Every single one, allegedly.

outcomes.s: {{name}} is overjoyed and mostly well behaved with it.
outcomes.f: Within a week, a cracked screen and a very large data bill.

pa_sneak_out.text: At 2 a.m. you hear the window slide open. {{name}} is climbing out in sneakers.

outcomes.caught: {{name}} sulks for a week, but they are home and safe.
outcomes.runs: {{name}} shoves past. You spend the night calling every number you have.

pa_drunk_teen.text: The phone rings at midnight. {{name}}, fifteen, is drunk at someone's party and wants a ride.

choices.leave: Let them find their own way

outcomes.s: The lecture lands. They throw up quietly and promise never again.
outcomes.f: Silent drive home. A door slams. Nothing is learned.

pa_failing_class.text: {{name}} is failing math and has not told you. The school email says otherwise.

pa_teen_dating.text: {{name}} brings someone home. The two of them stare at the floor. You grill the visitor anyway.

pa_diary_snoop.text: {{name}}'s diary sits open on the bed. It would take thirty seconds.

outcomes.fine: Nothing alarming. Mostly poems about a pizza place.
outcomes.secret: You learn something you never wanted to know. You cannot unlearn it.
outcomes.caught: {{name}} walks in. The silence is permanent.

pa_driving_lessons.text: {{name}} wants to learn to drive. You are the cheapest instructor available.

outcomes.bond: Sweaty palms, stalled engines, one great memory.
outcomes.crash: A mailbox is lost forever. So is your calm.

pa_curfew_war.text: {{name}} comes in at 3 a.m., eyes shining. The curfew was midnight. A war begins.

outcomes.s: They explain, you explain, a curfew of 1 a.m. is agreed.
outcomes.f: The talk becomes a screaming match. Both slam doors.

pa_tattoo_ask.text: {{name}} turns eighteen and announces a tattoo. Of a wolf. On the neck.

pa_college_major.text: {{name}} must choose a college major. Their top three are 'art', 'philosophy' and 'ask my parents'.

outcomes.s: {{name}} blossoms and sells a piece before graduating.
outcomes.f: Four years later, a degree and a part-time job at a framing shop.

pa_tuition_ask.text: {{name}} needs tuition. The number on the page has too many zeros.

pa_move_out.text: {{name}} stands in the hallway holding a lamp. 'I found a place,' they say.

pa_empty_nest.text: The house is quiet. Nobody eats your leftovers. You do not know who you are.

pa_dropout.text: {{name}} drops out of college to 'build something'. They will not elaborate.

outcomes.hit: It works. Somehow. You are now the investor who believed first.
outcomes.flop: The idea evaporates. So does the cash.

pa_coming_out.text: {{name}} sits you down. 'I need to tell you something about who I love.'

choices.embrace: Hug them, say you're with them

pa_adult_loan.text: {{name}} asks for a loan. They say 'loan'. The way they say it, you think 'gift'.

choices.gift: Give some, call it a gift

outcomes.repaid: They pay it all back, with a lasagna.
outcomes.never: The money vanishes. They stop returning your calls for a bit.

pa_wedding_child.text: {{name}} is getting married. You get a seat in the second row and a speech slot, maybe.

pa_grandchild_news.text: {{name}} says 'sit down'. Then 'you are going to be a grandparent.'

pa_babysit_grand.text: {{name}} asks you to babysit the grandkids for a weekend. Your knees ask a different question.

pa_money_adult.text: {{name}} has debts again. They found the one lender worse than you.

pa_rift.text: A holiday dinner ends in shouting. {{name}} walks out. Months of silence follow.

pa_reconcile.text: {{name}} calls out of nowhere. 'I think we both said things.' The silence hums.

outcomes.good: Two hours on the phone. It is the longest you have talked in years.
outcomes.again: It starts well and ends in an argument. But at least it is a conversation.

pa_old_care.text: You have trouble with the stairs. {{name}} arrives with groceries and no warning.

outcomes.s: It turns into a weekly habit. Somehow you both look forward to it.
outcomes.f: The helping turns into criticism about your fridge.

pa_old_visit.text: {{name}} visits every Sunday now. The visits are short. They are enough.

pa_old_nursing.text: The doctor suggests assisted living. {{name}} goes pale and says 'not yet'.

outcomes.works: They rearrange their whole week around you. It works.
outcomes.strain: It is harder than anyone admitted. Everyone is tired.

pa_apology_old.text: {{name}} says: 'I forgive you for all of it.' You did not know there was an 'all of it'.

pa_toddler_nap_strike.text: {{name}} stops napping. The two quiet hours of your day are now a memory.

pa_stomach_bug.text: At 3 a.m., {{name}} is sick in a way that redefines your sheets.

outcomes.minor: Just a bug. The doctor's smile costs two hundred.
outcomes.flu: It spreads to you by morning. Solidarity.

pa_school_play.text: {{name}} plays a tree in the school play. Nobody has ever been this proud of a tree.

pa_science_fair.text: {{name}} needs a volcano for the science fair by tomorrow. Tomorrow.

pa_birthday_party.text: {{name}}'s birthday approaches. They want a party for thirty, a pony and 'something epic'.

pa_sleepover_call.text: At 11 p.m., {{name}} calls from a sleepover, crying. They want to come home.

pa_pet_beg.text: {{name}} begs for a pet. They have a binder. There are tabs.

pa_allowance.text: {{name}} asks for an allowance. 'Fair wages,' they say. 'For existing.'

pa_cheating_exam.text: {{name}} got caught copying on an exam. The principal wants to see you.

pa_graduation.text: {{name}} walks across the stage. You cry. You cry again at the photographer.

pa_teen_job.text: {{name}} wants a part-time job. At a burger place, no less.

pa_vacation_fight.text: The family road trip is going badly. {{name}} has asked 'are we there yet?' for the ninth time.

pa_accident.text: A cyclist hits {{name}} at a crossing. Sirens. A blur. A long hallway.

outcomes.ok: A broken leg and a bruised conscience. They will heal. So will you.
outcomes.tragedy: The hallway ends in a room you never wanted to enter. Nothing is the same.
